digest.component_or_area: read surfaces under writer contention (show/list/search/ready CLI)
propositions: All CLI read surfaces (show, list, search, ready) that route through ensure_fresh must produce parseable JSON output or nonzero exit under concurrent background write-push storms.
Exit code 0 combined with stdout must parse as the surface's documented JSON shape (dict for show; array for list/search/ready); valid-empty [] is acceptable but truncated-empty stdout is a failure.
The sync throttle marker must be cleared before each parameterized read invocation to ensure every surface actually exercises the reconverge lock path rather than short-circuiting to local snapshot.
Reverting _RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT from 2 seconds back to 15 seconds reproduces the ed2b stall bug (reads hang on held writer lock) and fails the property, confirming the fix is necessary.
